'''Dmitry Sychugov''' ({{langx|ru|Дми́трий Ю́рьевич Сычу́гов}}) (born 1955) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[https://cs.msu.ru/persons/1058 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He graduated from the faculty [[MSU CMC]] (1976). Has been working at [[Moscow State University]] since 1980.

He defended the thesis «Mathematical modeling of plasma confinement processes in toroidal traps» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2013).

He is the author of five books and more than 80 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/D.Yu.Sychugov/ Scientific works of Dmitry Sychugov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=37997&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Dmitry Sychugov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>

'''Area of scientific interests''': mathematical modeling, computational physics of plasma.<ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=37997&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Dmitry Sychugov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
